name: [DUELS] Advanced Ragdoll Fighting
desc:
IF YOU HAVE NOT RECIEVED SOME OF GAMEPASSES THEN YOU NEED TO EQUIP IT IN SHOP



A free-roam ragdoll game with melee system, where you can have fun with ragdoll system and fight with other players at the same time. Generally a remake of BRE (Bloody Ragdoll Engine).



Controls:

PC / Keyboard: Shift - Run / Ctrl - Camera Lock / R - Ragdoll / H - Dances

Console / Gamepad: ButtonX - Ragdoll / ButtonY - Run / D-Pad Left - Emotes menu / D-Pad Up - Camera Lock



Owner: dementiadev (known as foxbigsosig)

Co-Owner / Manager: ArteryAlex
